g.title: REST API + webhook sender (TRANSACTION_SETTLED, signed POST)
Let's Encrypt TLS, proxies to the container on 127.0.0.1 only
Verifies X-Up-Authenticity-Signature (HMAC-SHA256), fetches the single referenced txn by ID
Incremental fetch via filter[since] and a persisted watermark, not a full refetch
In-process background goroutine started by -serve, not an OS cron job - runs immediately on startup, then every CRON_INTERVAL (default 1h)
base units/dollars -> milliunits, payee + date mapping, plus Up-to-Up transfer linking (transferAccount + transactionType "Transfer" -> real YNAB transfer via payee_id)
import_id = source txn ID (hashed if over 36 chars), idempotent, retries on rate limit
